profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Product Engineering | Applied AI
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack software engineer who loves building things front to back. I'm at my happiest working on high-impact projects, taking ownership of difficult problems, and turning ideas into software people can actually use.

Over the past 4+ years, I've worked across startup and enterprise environments, building full-stack products, leading features from planning through delivery, and helping other engineers get up to speed on complex systems.

More recently, I've been exploring how AI can solve practical product problems, including independently designing and shipping an AI-powered document validation system that combines semantic retrieval, deterministic validation, and LLM-assisted analysis.

I enjoy learning quickly, working across the stack, and figuring things out when the path forward isn't obvious.

positions.title: L3 Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Independently designed and shipped an AI-powered document validation system in ~10 working days that flags contract submission discrepancies before review using OCR, semantic retrieval, deterministic validation, and LLM-assisted analysis, enabling users to self-correct issues through citation-backed validation embedded directly into submission workflows.

• Scaled the validation pipeline to reliably handle submissions containing 100+ documents through partial-coverage handling, incremental artifact reuse, LLM reranking, and repeatable evaluation tooling, while designing reusable model-provider, vector-store, and caching abstractions for future validation use cases.

• Served as feature lead across multiple initiatives, driving implementation planning, facilitating technical discussions, onboarding engineers, and coordinating delivery from design through production.

• Led technical onboarding for a senior engineer joining a multi-system API ecosystem, creating architecture diagrams and walkthroughs covering authentication, API interactions, data ownership, and integrations across interconnected platforms.

• Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and client stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and deliver scalable solutions in highly regulated healthcare environments.

positions.title: L2 Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an end-to-end backend feature for a large government logistics platform, creating database tables, APIs, service objects, Swagger definitions, and automated tests while proactively building supporting functionality to accelerate future sprint delivery.

• Delivered a long-awaited production feature through a complex form architecture refactor spanning feature-flagged workflows, enabling rollout of new contract and rate submission capabilities.

• Independently delivered a large-scale refactor of a critical application workflow under tight timelines, helping demonstrate the feasibility of a production release that had previously been considered months away.

• Took ownership of legacy codebase modernization efforts, removing 95 orphaned files and nearly 5,000 lines of unused code to reduce technical debt and improve maintainability.

• Identified and resolved data integrity issues through PostgreSQL migrations, Go backend changes, and frontend updates while contributing across React, Go, PostgreSQL, APIs, and automated testing.

• Collaborated with engineering leads and client stakeholders to evaluate technical approaches and deliver product enhancements while minimizing unnecessary complexity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as one of four engineers responsible for building and supporting a consumer fintech platform, contributing across frontend, backend, cloud services, and internal tooling within a small startup engineering team.

• Led backend development for key product features, including product discovery, social sharing, and item returns, building Node.js/Firebase APIs and Google Cloud Functions that powered core iOS application experiences.

• Built mobile-first sharing experiences from Figma designs, including the frontend and supporting backend functionality that allowed users to share products outside the application.

• Built internal React and Firebase applications that enabled product data management and enrichment workflows supporting core platform experiences.

• Created Puppeteer web scrapers and custom migration scripts to automate data collection, improve product data quality, and support large-scale database updates.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Node.js · PubSub · Mocha (JavaScript Framework) · TypeScript · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Firebase · Cloud Firestore · IntelliJ IDEA · Puppeteer · Figma · Forrester's Four Tier Architecture · Automated Software Testing · CI/CD · Gitlab · Google Storage · Chai

positions.title: Warehouse Associate
positions.description:
• Inbound/Outbound processing and sorting of customer packages using handheld android device 
• Routinely push, pulled, and lifted containers 50+ pounds
• Applied industry safety standards, including Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards for lifting, working at heights and hazardous chemical handling

positions.title: Video Editor/Production Assistant/Event Photographer
positions.description:
• Promotional video editing for SF Film Finals Festival
• Conceptualizing shoot ideas
• Processing & organizing media files
• Editing both picture and sound to create a polished final product for theater and internet release
• Worked on set setting markers for actors, helping move equipment, and actively coordinated shots with the cinematographer as well

positions.title: Sales Floor Associate
positions.description:
• Recovered and properly organized sale areas
• In store IT repair for registers and computer systems
• Facilitated a positive purchase/refund experience for customers

positions.title: Fuego Intern
positions.description:
• Aiding youth in learning the basics of ARC welding
• Setting up and maintaining both a clean and safe working environment
• Fixing malfunctioning equipment
• Employing creative problem solving and good social skills to make the work of the students and teacher as efficient as possible

projects.title: Anywhere-Fitness
projects.description:
Online classroom enrollment and management tool for remote fitness classes

Node.js | Express | Knex | SQL | JWT | Bcrypt

• Powered a full-stack web application by building a RESTful API and deploying it via Heroku for front-end team members to use

• Setup endpoints which implemented SQL queries to manipulate data tables and persist data

• Properly hashed and stored user passwords upon sign up as well as verified hashed passwords upon login using Bcrypt

• Tested endpoint functionality with Jest
